runs.note: Compares Claude Sonnet 5.5 and GPT-6 Luna, each reached two ways (through its maker's API and through its command-line app), with two models running on the Mac itself. Generalist mode was on. The run stopped early because of a fault in our test equipment, so a few tasks never ran. Some failures came from our tests or from how gezel connected to the command-line apps, not from the models, and are not counted against them. A model without a result for every task in a set is left out of that table rather than counted as passing. The command-line apps were tested again on October 12 after those problems were fixed.
